dialogues.speaker: Farooq
dialogues.text: With the Corps of Thirty around, pickpockets wouldn't dare come around often.

dialogues.speaker: Farooq
dialogues.text: If you see someone who looks exactly like me, watch your wallet.

dialogues.speaker: Farooq
dialogues.text: He's my twin brother. A petty thief who talks nonsense all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Farooq
dialogues.text: Don't let him rub off on you. Just keep an eye on his actions.
